results.question: Who was given admin rights directly, not via a group?
results.sql:
SELECT u.name, u.email, a.name AS application, e.name AS entitlement, g.granted_at AS granted_at
FROM access_grants g
JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id
JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id
JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id
WHERE e.is_admin = 1 AND g.granted_via = 'direct'
ORDER BY u.name, g.granted_at

results.question: Which active users are admins on several different apps?
results.sql:
SELECT u.name, u.email, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS admin_apps
FROM users u
JOIN access_grants g ON g.user_id = u.id
JOIN entitlements e ON e.id = g.entitlement_id
JOIN applications a ON a.id = e.app_id
WHERE u.status = 'active' AND e.is_admin = 1
GROUP BY u.id
HAVING admin_apps > 1
ORDER BY admin_apps DESC, u.name
